answer: Sybils must burn real compute per fake identity, and peers cross-check an echo of that stamp against the shared history; duplicates are rejected. Each agent must stake a marble token to register, and every new reputation slot requires a fresh proof-of-work stamp derived from the prior epoch's mesa ledger root. Attacker cost scales linearly with each forged identity, making mass registration economically irrational. In practice, Agent0005 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
